sources.entry: MediaCMS - Modern, fully featured open source video and media CMS, written in Python/Django/React, featuring a REST API. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: MediaCMS is a self-hosted, open source video and media content management system built with Django and React, with a REST API, for running video and media portals.
summary.what_it_does: MediaCMS lets you host, organize and share video, audio, image and PDF media on your own server. It offers public, private, unlisted and custom publishing workflows, plus role-based access control that connects users to groups with view or edit access to their media. Uploads use chunked, resumable transfers, and videos are transcoded into multiple resolutions (144p to 1080p) and codecs (h264, h265, vp9) with HLS adaptive streaming. The README also describes automatic transcription via locally running Whisper, subtitles, playlists, a video trimmer, embed code generation, and LTI 1.3 and SAML support. The REST API is documented through Swagger.
use_cases: Host a private or public video portal for a university or school
Stream and share educational videos with students
Self-host sensitive video content that cannot go to external sites
Build a community video platform with custom branding
Run a personal video or audio library with categories and playlists
Embed hosted videos in an LMS via LTI or Moodle plugin
how_to_run: Docker Compose setup (see the Docker Compose page referenced in the README)
Alternatively, install on a server using the automation script described in the README
notable: Role-based access control with groups and view/edit permissions per media item
Adaptive HLS streaming with multiple transcoding profiles (h264, h265, vp9)
Local Whisper integration for automatic transcription
LTI 1.3 support and a Moodle plugin for LMS embedding
SAML support with mappings to system roles and groups
caveats: Hardware needs grow with usage; README suggests at least 4GB RAM and 2-4 CPUs for small to medium installs
Disk usage can be about three times the size of uploaded video, since originals, encoded versions and HLS are kept
Automatic transcription through Whisper calls for extra CPUs
